    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Group Stage: Febuary 1st - 23rd
      • Swiss with 3 Rounds
      • All matches are Ft2
      • Top 8 teams advance to Playoffs
    • Playoffs: March 2nd - 10th
      • Single elimination bracket
      • All matches are Ft3
